name: Digital Asset Technologies Inc.
summary: Eat & Beyond Global Holdings Inc. functions as an investment company, operating as both a private equity and venture capital fund. It deploys capital across diverse business development phases, ranging from nascent startups and emerging enterprises to more mature growth and expansion-stage companies, as well as facilitating strategic buy-ins or complete buyouts. The firm primarily targets investments within the rapidly expanding plant-based protein and alternative meat food industry. Specifically, it actively seeks and acquires equity positions in ventures involved with plant-based, fermented, and cultured proteins, cellular agriculture, broader food technology solutions, consumer packaged goods, and various other pioneering, experimental projects. Geographically, the company shows a preference for investments in North America, Europe, Israel, and countries across Asia and Latin America. A key aspect of its strategy is to secure controlling majority stakes in its portfolio companies. Founded in 2019, Eat & Beyond Global Holdings Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
